label: Whatever is in potency in no respect operates from itself. q.18 a.3 ad 2 says of God that he is…
paraphrase: OPEN bridge: whatever is in potency in no respect operates from itself (has an immanent operation, actio quae manet in agente, q.18 a.3 ad 1). q.18 a.3 ad 2 says of God that he is his own understanding and his own living; the bridge generalizes this to every pure act.
